messages:
Anjali (Product): Quick ask — can we add a 'prepaid-cache amortization' preview in the Cost Forecast panel? PM wants customers to toggle how prefetch credits get applied before committing to a Dedicated/Reserved plan.

Derek (Eng-Platform): This would be helpful. UX toggles: [Allocate prefetch savings -> by tenant | by route]. Backend: need per-invocation fields for prefetch tokens + origin tag. Currently only token_count and cache_hit.

Kevin (Data): Proposal for telemetry: add `prefetch_tokens`, `prefetch_origin` (values: shared_slab, tenant_slab, ephemeral), `prefetch_credit_applied` (bool). With sample_rate we can extrapolate. Minimal change to the invocation proto.

Sofia (Design): I'll make 2 small mocks: one where forecast shows amortized monthly debit per-tenant, one where it attributes to routes. Need sample granularity (hourly) and a deterministic allocation rule so the numbers don't jump on each hover.

Derek (Eng-Platform): Implementation plan: 1) telemetry schema + ingest change, 2) short backfill/approximation for last 7 days, 3) UI toggle + simulation slider (forecast horizon). Example event payload we should accept:

```json
{
  "route": "/generate",
  "tenant_id": "acct_42",
  "tokens": 120,
  "prefetch_tokens": 80,
  "prefetch_origin": "shared_slab"
}
```

Kevin (Data): For sampling we should also emit `sampled: true` and `prefetch_sample_rate` in the envelope. Then ingestion can scale counts by 1/sample_rate when aggregating.

Derek (Eng-Platform): Edge cases: shared_slab prefetches need a deterministic splitter for partial credit when multiple routes benefit. Suggest we expose a `prefetch_affinity_tag` if caller can supply it; default to `route` attribution otherwise.

infra-bot: PR opened by @derek -> https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4823 — adds proto fields + unit tests. CI: ✅

Anjali (Product): Timeline? PMs want a quick demo for Friday's sync to show the idea (doesn't need perfect backfill).

Derek (Eng-Platform): Realistic: telemetry + ingest change this sprint, basic UI simulation next sprint. I can wire a synthetic demo using sampled data by EOD Thursday.

Sofia (Design): I'll post compact mocks (two states) in #design in 30m and label which bits are purely visual vs needing API support. :thumbsup:
